name: dsh-lark
description: Alias for dsh-lark-channel, the Lark/Feishu IM bot channel for DeepSeek Harness. Install dsh-lark-channel instead.
readme:
# dsh-lark

This name is an alias. The package is **[`dsh-lark-channel`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lark-channel)** — a Lark/Feishu IM bot channel for DeepSeek Harness.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lark-channel
dsh web
```

Installing `dsh-lark` pulls `dsh-lark-channel` in and re-exports it, but it declares no `dsh.bundle`, so it will not activate as a profile layer. Use `dsh-lark-channel` directly.

Source and documentation: <https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-lark>

---

本包只是名字别名，真正的包是 **[`dsh-lark-channel`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lark-channel)**，DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark IM 机器人渠道插件。安装请直接用 `dsh-lark-channel`。
